arborescence.note: order_formula and arborescence_identity are Lemma A and Proposition B per faithful gamma; row_expansion and strictness are Theorem M per pair (gamma1 faithful, gamma2 arbitrary of positive degree without trivial constituent); dv2_ratio is Proposition B(i) per vertex. bad counts every failure of any of them.

superadditivity.note: Corollary M2 for pairs and triples of faithful representations with no determinant condition; min_slack 0 shows the bound is tight (attained already for l = 1).

monotonicity_unconditional.note: Theorem M with no determinant condition on either summand: gamma_1 faithful without trivial constituent, gamma_2 any representation of positive degree (trivial constituents allowed). violations counts |K(gamma_1+gamma_2)| < |K(gamma_1)|; strict_equalities counts equality with gamma_2 not a multiple of the trivial character (Theorem M forbids both); trivial_gamma2_cases are the cases where gamma_2 IS a multiple of the trivial character, every one of which gave exact equality.

m1_hypothesis.note: Corollary M1 applies (F1) to the summand gamma_1, so it needs det gamma_1 = 1. det1_below_Gab must be 0 (else (F1) itself would be contradicted); detnot1_below_Gab > 0 shows the hypothesis cannot be dropped. Found during a self-check against Theorem 8, whose gamma = det rho^-1 + rho has det gamma = 1 but det rho != 1.
